scenario: two gross lines taxed together keep their gross prices when the group is shared back
source: tax-inclusive pricing rule: a gross price is what the customer pays, so its share of a group keeps it
note: The group's tax, 3.3333, rounds once to 3.33 and is shared 1.67 and 1.66; each line keeps its 10.00. Sharing the net instead would price them at 10.01 and 9.99.
